content: The bench room is locked until day 3. Let me record this and check the current time.

args.lesson: In the Workshop, the Gold Door at (7,6) blocks the bench room (workbench at (10,5), plus Wood at (9,1) and Stone at (10,1)); a Gold Key is left by the door on the morning of day 3, so the bench room cannot be entered before day 3.
